sections.title: Your success *is our priority*
body: Austin & Pethick offers comprehensive legal services for individuals, families and businesses in Aiken and the surrounding area, built on trust, transparency and a client-first approach.
Chris Austin is a lifelong Aiken County resident and Silver Bluff High School graduate, a University of South Carolina alumnus, and holds a master of laws in taxation from the University of Alabama.

items.a: Estate planning helps everyone, whatever their age or wealth: it makes sure your wishes are followed and names guardians for minor children.
Usually a Last Will & Testament, a power of attorney and an advance directive (living will). We’ll advise on what fits your situation.
Yes, as often as your circumstances change. We can help keep it current.

items.q: Do I need a lawyer to start a business?
items.a: It isn’t always required, but legal guidance protects your interests and sets up the right structure for growth.

items.q: What do you handle for government contracts?
items.a: Bid proposals, contract negotiations and staying compliant with government regulations.
